# Town of Waltham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Anthony Duprey, Don Ross, and Rhonda Williams for Waltham's three-member board

Town of Waltham, 2026 Town Report (posted on the town's Town Meetings & Reports page): the pre-meeting elected-officials table lists Dan Morris (term to 2028) as the third member and Don Ross as Moderator; the June 2026 directory and the post-meeting state give Ross the seat -- Morris departed and Ross took the seat (divergence disclosed on #163)

Town of Waltham, 2026 Town Report (posted on the town's Town Meetings & Reports page): the APPOINTED officials table lists Rose Russett as Town Clerk, 'Effective 3/1/26' -- Waltham's clerk is appointed, so no election is recorded for the office. The Secretary of State's Guide lists Linda Devino, whom the report's dedication page shows served 2021-2025 (stale)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Rose Russett as Waltham's Town Clerk

Town of Waltham, 2026 Town Report (posted on the town's Town Meetings & Reports page): the APPOINTED officials table lists Rose Russett as Town Treasurer, 'Effective 3/1/26' -- the office is appointed in Waltham
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Rose Russett as Waltham's Town Treasurer

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term; Don Ross held the office to 2026 per the 2026 report and the 2026 outcome is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

jp_election.name: Town of Waltham Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the three winners of Waltham's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for three): Roberta 'Cookie' Steponaitis, Terrance Evarts, and Rachel Steponaitis. All three remain in office
